SELECT articles.id, articles.title, articles.summary, articles.content, articles.imageUrl, articles.isTop, articles.status, articles.createTime, articles.updateTime, articles.view_count, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(l.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM label l, JSON_TABLE(articles.tags, '$[*]' COLUMNS (tag_id VARCHAR(50) PATH '$')) AS tag_list WHERE l.id = CAST(tag_list.tag_id AS UNSIGNED) ) AS tags FROM articles
AND articles.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{titleSearch}, '%')
AND JSON_CONTAINS(articles.tags, CAST(#{tagId} AS CHAR))
And status=1
order by isTop desc, articles.createTime desc

SELECT articles.id, articles.title, articles.summary, articles.content, articles.imageUrl, articles.isTop, articles.status, articles.createTime, articles.updateTime, articles.view_count, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(l.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM label l, JSON_TABLE(articles.tags, '$[*]' COLUMNS (tag_id VARCHAR(50) PATH '$')) AS tag_list WHERE l.id = CAST(tag_list.tag_id AS UNSIGNED) ) AS tags FROM articles where articles.id=#{id}

SELECT articles.id, articles.title, articles.summary, articles.content, articles.imageUrl, articles.isTop, articles.status, articles.createTime, articles.updateTime, articles.view_count, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(l.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM label l, JSON_TABLE(articles.tags, '$[*]' COLUMNS (tag_id VARCHAR(50) PATH '$')) AS tag_list WHERE l.id = CAST(tag_list.tag_id AS UNSIGNED) ) AS tags FROM articles order by createTime desc
